skillFull: Moves ahead, sprinkling salt and pickling the ground at regular intervals. While performing the ritual, a mystical power prevents collisions with obstacles and slows down the Energy drain. White Radish Jellies are created from the pickled ground at regular intervals. Level Up for slower Energy drain and more points for White Radish Jellies.
story:
The sacred Kimchi Bell that lifts the spirits with its clear, calming chime. Passed down through White Kimchi Cookie's family for generations, this mystical bell is said to have been bestowed upon the first shaman by the great deity.

With every ring, pure energy ripples outward, quietly driving away the shadows that linger in the dark. Listen closely, and even the darkest thoughts may simply drift away!

costumes.name: Big Dipper Norigae
costumes.info: Kimchi Bell lingers at the edge of the Bridge Ritual. Easy to mistake it for a fancy ornament, but when a spirit's time to pass on comes, it rings out clear to show the way. Like the Big Dipper in a clear night sky, may the road ahead shine bright for all who depart!
